description: RbNa₂B₆O₁₀Br crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Rb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are two shorter (3.01 Å) and two longer (3.06 Å) Rb-O bond lengths. Both Rb-Br bond lengths are 3.36 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-3.02 Å. There is one shorter (3.12 Å) and one longer (3.34 Å) Na-Br bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are two shorter (2.30 Å) and two longer (2.55 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-Br bond lengths are 3.23 Å. There are four inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.37 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.53 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the fourth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.54 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two B atoms. Br is bonded to two equivalent Rb and four Na atoms to form distorted corner-sharing BrRb₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°.
